title: Core Pronouns - The Building Blocks
description: Master the 9 most essential words in French. These are your foundation - they communicate who is talking, who they are talking to, and who you're talking about.
can_do: Use all 9 essential French pronouns (I, you, he, she, we, they)
Understand the foundation for all French sentences

vocabulary.note: ⭐ Uses il/elle verb forms! More common than 'nous'!

concepts.definition: Words that replace nouns as the subject of a sentence
concepts.example: 9 essential words: I, you, he, she, we, you (formal), they (masc), they (fem), {on}

concepts.definition: 4 singular pronouns (one person) and 4 plural pronouns (multiple people)
concepts.example: I/you/he/she are singular, we/you all/they are plural

concepts.definition: French has TWO words for "you" - informal (friends) and formal (strangers/bosses)
concepts.example: Friends vs strangers require different pronouns

concepts.definition: The most common way to say 'we' in French - more natural than '{nous}'
concepts.example: {On va au café} (We're going to the café) - uses il/elle verb forms, not nous forms

items.situation: You're talking about yourself. Use this pronoun
You're talking to a friend. Use this pronoun
items.hint: Informal second person - use with friends

mistakes.feedback: That's formal 'you' - use tu with friends

items.situation: You're talking about a man. Use this pronoun
You're talking about a woman. Use this pronoun
You're talking about yourself and others. Use this pronoun
You're talking to a stranger or your boss. Use this pronoun
items.hint: Formal second person - use with strangers or multiple people

mistakes.feedback: That's informal - use vous with strangers

items.situation: You're talking about a group of men (or mixed group). Use this pronoun

mistakes.feedback: That's feminine 'they', use ils for masculine/mixed

items.situation: You're talking about a group of women. Use this pronoun
items.hint: Third person plural feminine - only for all-female groups

mistakes.feedback: That's masculine 'they', use elles for all-feminine

items.situation: You're talking informally about yourself and others. Use this pronoun
items.hint: The most natural way to say 'we' in French - uses il/elle verb forms

mistakes.feedback: That's formal 'we' - on is more common and natural
